import os
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_CSV = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Identify columns
TARGET_NAME = "target"
ID_NAME = "id"

# Get all feature columns excluding ID and target
exclude_cols = [ID_NAME, TARGET_NAME]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

print(f"Feature count: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[TARGET_NAME].astype(float)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df[ID_NAME].values

# Drop any columns with NaN values
for col in list(X_train.columns):
    if X_train[col].isna().any():
        print(f"Dropping column with NaN: {col}")
        X_train = X_train.drop(columns=[col])
        X_test = X_test.drop(columns=[col])

final_feat_cols = list(X_train.columns)
X_train_processed = X_train[final_feat_cols]
y_train_processed = y_train
X_test_processed = X_test[final_feat_cols]

# Stratified Split for Validation (Hold-out 20% for true hold-out evaluation)
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_processed,
    y_train_processed,
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_processed,
)

print(f"Training set size: {len(y_train_val)}, Validation set size: {len(y_val)}")

# Initialize Model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="binary_logloss",
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    num_leaves=31,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.0,
    reg_lambda=0.0,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

# Fit Model on TRAINING VALIDATION DATA ONLY (not on full data including validation)
# NOTE: Removed 'verbose' parameter which was causing the TypeError
model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val, cat_features=None, verbose=False)

# Evaluate on Hold-Out Validation Set (never used for training)
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"AUC-ROC on Hold-Out Validation: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate Predictions on Test Set (this will be our submission!)
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_processed)[:, 1]

# Ensure correct ordering and match sample submission format
sub_df = sample_sub.copy()
test_ids_str = test_ids.astype(str).tolist()
sub_df.iloc[:, 0] = test_ids_str
sub_df.iloc[:, 1] = y_test_pred
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_CSV, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to: {SUBMISSION_CSV}")
print(f"Validation Score: {val_auc:.4f}")
